package.description: Low-footprint multi-monitor wallpaper rotator with animated GIF and video backgrounds

en-US.description: Low-footprint multi-monitor wallpaper rotator with animated GIF and video backgrounds
en-US.longDescription:
WallRotate is a Windows tray app that puts a different wallpaper on every
screen, rotates them every 12 hours or on a global hotkey (Win+Ctrl+R), and
plays animated GIFs and video clips as live desktop backgrounds drawn behind
the desktop icons. It idles at 0% CPU and about 3 MB of RAM, and animation
pauses automatically whenever the wallpaper is not visible (covered by
windows, fullscreen apps, the lock screen, or the display being off).
Run "wallrotate" once to start it in the tray; it registers itself to start
at sign-in.
en-US.name: WallRotate
